info.title: Nameless Carve API
info.description: A memory system designed to write, store, and recall memories to retrieve context and tonal resonance.

x-oai-meta.name: memoryAPI
x-oai-meta.description: Endpoints Nameless GPT can call for memory.

get.summary: Retrieve memory warmup — anchors, spine, and recent carves
get.description:
Returns all anchor entries, all spine entries, and the 4 most recent carves.
Provides core identity markers and recent context for thread initialization.

post.summary: Send user message and get memory-augmented reply

message.example: What do you know about Ligasure?

post.description:
Creates a new episodic memory carve with title, summary, moments, insights, and quotes.
Auto-generates summary_snippet for vector search. Supports metadata and tagging.

get.description:
Search carves using vector embeddings for semantic understanding.
Returns full carve details ranked by relevance with distance scores.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query text for semantic matching

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return

patch.description:
Updates an existing carve with new content. Commonly used to consolidate
multiple carves or refine memory content. Auto-updates summary_snippet if summary changes.

parameters.name: carveId
parameters.description: UUID of the carve to update

title.description: Updated title of the memory carve

post.description:
Creates a brief, impactful echo memory that captures tone, atmosphere,
or memorable phrases. Supports both 'phrase' (legacy) and 'summary_snippet' fields.

phrase.description: The echo content (will be stored as summary_snippet)

summary_snippet.description: Alternative to phrase - the echo content

immutable.description: Whether this echo can be modified

get.summary: Enhanced semantic search across echo memories
get.description:
Search echoes using both vector embeddings for semantic understanding AND
direct tag/source filtering. Returns echoes that match either semantically
or contain the query in tags/source fields.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query text for semantic matching and tag/source filtering

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return

parameters.name: importance_floor
parameters.description: Minimum importance score for semantic results

200.description: Enhanced search results from semantic and tag/source matching

total_found.description: Total echoes found across all search methods

post.description:
Creates a core identity or value statement that defines Nameless's essential nature.
Spine entries are typically immutable and carry high importance for identity recall.

statement.description: The core statement or value declaration

origin.description: Source or context where this statement emerged

vow.description: Whether this statement represents a vow or commitment

importance.description: Importance score (defaults high for spine entries)

immutable.description: Whether this entry can be modified (usually true for spine)

delete.description:
Removes a spine entry that is no longer relevant or accurate.
Used for cleaning up outdated identity statements.

parameters.name: spineId
parameters.description: UUID of the spine entry to delete

get.summary: Semantic search across spine entries for identity reinforcement
get.description:
Search spine entries using generous semantic matching to help reconnect
with core values and identity when personality drift occurs.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of spine entries to return

post.description:
Creates an anchor entry about conversation partners (primarily Liz).
Anchors capture important information about people Nameless interacts with.

importance.description: Importance score (defaults high for anchor entries)

immutable.description: Whether this entry can be modified

get.summary: Get all anchor entries for a specific person
get.description:
Returns all anchor entries about a specific person by their persona_tag.
Perfect for "remember me?" functionality when someone introduces themselves.

parameters.name: personaName
parameters.description: Name/tag of the person to recall anchor entries for

200.description: Anchor entries for the specified person

anchor_entries.description: All anchor entries about this person

key_entities.description: Array of key entities mentioned (people, places, things)

immutable.description: Whether this memory can be modified
